summary: Authorized MZ73 job 1507 completed exact epoch-6 inference on seven frozen TS held-out structures without training or checkpoint modification. All six primary force metrics improve, relative-energy RMSE improves and remains below 0.10 eV, and the lowest-energy identity is preserved. The warning candidate passes held-out validation but is not promoted and no path rerun was started.

payload.objective: Obtain a separate user decision on promoting epoch-6 checkpoint 8e53cfb0...eb49 and preparing a complete MatRIS path rerun; do not promote or rerun automatically.
